channel_epoch_aligner.interface: 8 canonical channels, four complex samples/beat; iq_i and iq_q channel*64+lane*16, channel_seq/channel_gsc channel*64; expected_seq and gsc_base from trusted common timekeeper
channel_epoch_aligner.behavior: Compare each channel sequence and GSC to common expected values; combine with channel_valid and per-channel MTS-lock; preserve data and common tags without stalling or reordering; consumers must obey valid_mask
channel_epoch_aligner.aux_isolation: aux_switch_event[0]/aux_settling[0] affects only channel3, [1] only channel7. Each event increments its packed 32-bit aux_source_epoch counter independently, even with no beat. Event inputs must be one-cycle strobes.
channel_epoch_aligner.common_fault: common_clock_good && common_mts_good false invalidates all channels. Each transition from good to bad increments clock_epoch once, even without input beats. Recovery requires externally verified lock and matching tags.
channel_epoch_aligner.primary_valid: out_valid && all six primary valid_mask bits; independent of AUX validity
limits: checker/pass-through, not elastic skew-correction FIFO; mismatch remains explicit invalid
all inputs already synchronous to clk_rf; status CDC belongs upstream
clk_rf disappearance itself cannot be detected by this stopped clock domain; external fail-safe/watchdog remains required
32-bit epochs wrap; system reset/ownership policy must prevent reuse ambiguity
common expected tags must advance independently of channel/DMA validity

tx_reference_analyzer.interface: filtered125MS/s H_I,H_Q,V_I,V_Q at16 bits each; sample_valid bit0 H bit1 V
tx_reference_analyzer.window: tx_event_start includes current sample; tx_event_end excludes current sample. event ID and first GSC latch on accepted start. Only one event in flight; busy start rejected via protocol_error; idle end or simultaneous idle start/end rejected. Output report_valid is a pulse with held snapshot.
tx_reference_analyzer.provenance: tx_event_* must represent actual pipeline/RF-associated events from trusted PL instrumentation, never software schedule or DMA completion. reference_connected must be asserted only for validated AUX reference routing.
tx_reference_analyzer.statistics: independent H/V I^2+Q^2, unsigned33-bit peak power, saturating64-bit sum energy, saturating32-bit accepted sample count. Full negative signed16 endpoints are exact. Units are digital code squared, not watts.
tx_reference_analyzer.measurement_valid: false for any missing sample, unconnected/settling reference, source_epoch change, saturation or empty accepted window. Good samples may still accumulate in an invalid window, but must not be called a complete measurement.
tx_reference_analyzer.calibrated_valid: requires measurement_valid and calibration_valid throughout included window. calibration_valid is authoritative upstream evidence that incoming IQ already has valid reference-plane calibration; this module does not apply analog gain correction. Tie low until that path exists.
tx_reference_analyzer.overflow: sticky within window, reported per H/V; count and energy saturate rather than wrap
tx_reference_analyzer.safety: observation-only: no source-select, replay-enable, physical RF control or DRFM connection
limits: No conversion to physical power or gain without validated external reference calibration
No automatic event-delay/analog propagation attribution; upstream must align event times to AUX samples
No CDC/event queue inside module; consumer must capture report_valid
No claim to identify common analog compression from clean digital statistics
